title: howto labs list
description: The Labs in the library's labs directory, sorted by id, cut to the first --limit when one is given.

id.description: The Lab's filename without `.md`, which `howto labs show` takes.

title.description: The Lab's first `# ` heading, or its id where it has none.

tags.description: The `tags` in its front matter, empty where it has none.
